name: project-setup
description: FastAPI project scaffold. Directory structure: backend/app/{routes,services,models,utils,core}. requirements.txt: fastapi, uvicorn, sqlalchemy[asyncio], asyncpg, pydantic-settings, python-jose[cryptography], boto3, mem0ai, anthropic, firebase-admin, python-multipart, httpx. Dockerfile with multi-stage build. Docker-compose for local dev (PostgreSQL + backend). ruff + mypy configuration.

name: database-schema
description: SQLAlchemy async models for all tables: profiles (id UUID Cognito sub, email, name, mem0_user_id, fcm_token, timezone, avatar_url, preferred_language, onboarding_completed, subscription_tier, subscription_expires_at, created_at), characters (id, user_id→profiles, name, template, description, system_prompt, mem0_agent_id, avatar_style, is_default, is_active, created_at), conversations (id, user_id, character_id UNIQUE, last_message_at, created_at), messages (id, conversation_id, user_id, role, content, media_url, tts_url, metadata JSONB, created_at), user_activity (user_id PK, last_active_at, last_chat_at, notifications_sent_today JSONB, updated_at), partners (id, user_id_1, user_id_2 nullable, invite_token, status, created_at), body_measurements (id, user_id, date, weight_kg, body_fat_pct, notes, created_at). Alembic migration. Critical indexes: messages(conversation_id, created_at DESC), conversations(user_id, last_message_at DESC).

name: cognito-auth-middleware
description: AWS Cognito JWT middleware for FastAPI. Verify RS256 JWT tokens against Cognito JWKS endpoint. Extract user_id from 'sub' claim. FastAPI Depends(get_current_user) injector. Handle token expiry (401), invalid token (401). Cache JWKS keys (10 min TTL). Environment vars: COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID, AWS_REGION.

name: auth-endpoints
description: POST /auth/register (Cognito signup + profiles row + Mem0 user creation + default General Friend character creation). POST /auth/login (Cognito authenticate, return access_token + refresh_token + user). POST /auth/refresh (Cognito refresh, return new access_token). Response schemas with Pydantic v2.

name: character-crud
description: GET /characters (list user's characters, include last_message_at from conversations). POST /characters (create character: validate template, auto-generate system_prompt via Claude Haiku, create Mem0 agent, auto-create single conversation row). PUT /characters/:id (update name/system_prompt/avatar_style, owner check). DELETE /characters/:id (soft delete is_active=false, General Friend is_default=true cannot be deleted → 403). All endpoints: JWT auth required, user_id from JWT.

name: chat-streaming
description: POST /characters/:id/messages SSE streaming endpoint. Steps: 1) Validate character belongs to user. 2) asyncio.gather(mem0_search(query, agent_id), db_get_last_50_messages(conversation_id)). 3) Build system prompt (character template + memories + current date/time/timezone). 4) Stream Claude Sonnet response (SSE: chunk events). 5) On stream complete: async background tasks: save user+assistant messages to DB, add to Mem0 memory. SSE format: data: {"type":"chunk","content":"..."}, data: {"type":"done","message_id":"uuid"}. Handle device action intents (alarm/calendar) via Claude Haiku intent extraction → data: {"type":"action","action":"SET_ALARM","payload":{...}}.

name: messages-pagination
description: GET /characters/:id/messages?cursor={iso_timestamp} — cursor-based pagination, returns 20 messages newest-first. NO OFFSET. Query: WHERE conversation_id=$1 AND created_at < $cursor ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20. Returns {messages: [...], next_cursor: "iso_timestamp or null"}. First request (no cursor): returns last 20 messages.

name: memory-endpoints
description: GET /characters/:id/memories (fetch from Mem0 using agent_id). DELETE /characters/:id/memories/:mem_id (delete from Mem0). DELETE /characters/:id/memories (clear all memories for character). GET /memories (global General Friend memories). All operations use Mem0 Python SDK.

name: onboarding-endpoint
description: POST /onboarding/complete — receives answers to 7 onboarding questions, seeds Mem0 memories for General Friend character (agent_id=companion_{user_id}). Sets profiles.onboarding_completed=true. Claude Haiku converts Q&A answers to structured Mem0 memory format.

name: media-upload
description: POST /media/upload-url — generates S3 presigned PUT URL. Request: {filename, content_type, type: "photo"|"audio"|"tts"}. Response: {upload_url, file_url}. S3 key format: {type}/{user_id}/{uuid}_{filename}. Validates content_type whitelist (image/jpeg, image/png, image/heic, audio/m4a, audio/mp3). 10MB max file size (enforced via presigned URL ContentLengthRange).

name: activity-tracking-middleware
description: FastAPI middleware that updates user_activity.last_active_at on every authenticated request. Updates last_chat_at when POST /characters/:id/messages is called. Upsert with ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE.

name: notification-scheduler
description: APScheduler async scheduler integrated with FastAPI lifespan. Cron job every 30 minutes. Checks all users for notification conditions: morning (08:00-09:30, no chat today), afternoon (14:00-15:30, no chat today), evening (20:00-21:00, no evening notif today), sleep (23:00+, active last 1h). Skips if user already received same type today (notifications_sent_today JSON array). Respects user timezone.

name: fcm-push-service
description: Firebase Admin SDK push notification service. send_notification(user_id, title, body, data). Data payload includes character_id for deep link. POST /notifications/token endpoint to register/update FCM token. Handles FCM token refresh.

name: proactive-message-generator
description: Claude Haiku generates personalized notification text using user Mem0 memories. Morning: "Günaydın {name}! {personalized based on memories}" — max 100 chars. Uses character's General Friend voice/personality. Caches generated messages per user per day.

name: ios-scaffold
description: Xcode project setup. SwiftUI app entry point with NavigationStack, TabView (Home/Memories/Profile tabs). EmberApp struct with AppStorage for auth state. Color/typography constants from docs/14-tasarim.md (Primary #5B4FE8, Accent #FF6B6B, Background #0F0F14, Surface #1A1A24, Surface2 #22223A). Package.swift dependencies: AWS Amplify Cognito, Kingfisher, Lottie, swift-markdown. Dark mode default. LaunchScreen.storyboard.

name: ios-network-layer
description: APIService class with URLSession. Base URL from environment. Authorization header injection. Generic request/response methods with Codable. SSE streaming: AsyncStream<String> from URLSession dataTask, parses data: {type,content} events. Error types: APIError enum. Retry logic for 401 (refresh token then retry once).

name: ios-cognito-auth
description: AWS Amplify Cognito integration. AuthService with signIn(email, password), signUp(email, password, name), signOut, refreshToken, getCurrentUser. @Observable AuthViewModel. Keychain storage for tokens. Auto-refresh on 401.

name: ios-onboarding
description: OnboardingFlow: WelcomeView (3-screen swipe with Lottie animations, "Get Started" CTA). QuestionsView (7 full-screen question cards, swipe between, progress indicator 1/7…7/7, skip option, submit all to POST /onboarding/complete). @Observable OnboardingViewModel.

name: ios-auth-screens
description: LoginView (email + password fields, sign in button, sign up link, error state). RegisterView (name + email + password, validation). Both use @Observable AuthViewModel. Keyboard avoidance. Loading states.

name: ios-home-view
description: HomeView with character grid. Fetch characters from GET /characters. LazyVGrid with character cards (avatar circle with role icon, name, last message preview, time badge, unread badge for proactive messages). "+ Add Character" card at end. Tapping character → ChatView (full-screen push, NOT new conversation). Daily summary card at top (last AI message from General Friend). @Observable HomeViewModel with pull-to-refresh.

name: ios-chat-view
description: ChatView — the core screen. Bubble UI: user right (primary color), AI left (surface2). SSE streaming display: words appear as chunks arrive, typing indicator (3-dot bounce Lottie). Markdown rendering with swift-markdown. Infinite scroll up (cursor pagination: GET /characters/:id/messages?cursor=). Send button + photo picker + voice button (Faz 5). Character name + avatar in navigation bar. @Observable ChatViewModel with messages: [Message], isStreaming: Bool. Haptics on send.

name: ios-memories-view
description: MemoriesView. Character segment picker. Fetch GET /characters/:id/memories per character. List grouped by category (Fitness, Nutrition, Personality, Life Events, etc.). Swipe-to-delete with confirmation. Empty state. @Observable MemoriesViewModel.

name: ios-profile-view
description: ProfileView. Profile photo (S3 upload via POST /media/upload-url). Name editing. Timezone picker. Notification toggles per character. Language preference. Partner section (Faz 8). Account section: change password, export data (JSON), delete account (with confirmation). @Observable ProfileViewModel.

name: ios-fcm-deeplinks
description: Firebase iOS SDK integration. Register device for FCM. Handle FCM token refresh → PUT /notifications/token. Deep link from notification: notification payload contains character_id → open ChatView for that character. Background/foreground notification handling. iOS 17+ notification permission request after first chat session ends.

name: android-scaffold
description: Android project with Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. build.gradle.kts with version catalog. Navigation Compose with bottom tab bar (Home/Memories/Profile). EmberTheme with Ember colors (#5B4FE8 primary, #FF6B6B accent, #0F0F14 background). Dark theme default via AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES. MainActivity + NavGraph. AWS Amplify, Coil, Lottie, OkHttp, Retrofit dependencies.

name: android-network-layer
description: Retrofit + OkHttp setup. AuthInterceptor adds Bearer token. Generic API response handling. OkHttp EventSource for SSE streaming (parses data: {type,content} events → emits to StateFlow). ApiResult sealed class. Automatic 401 refresh + retry. Base URL from BuildConfig.

name: android-cognito-auth
description: AWS Amplify Cognito Android. AuthRepository with signIn, signUp, signOut, refreshToken. Encrypted SharedPreferences for token storage. AuthViewModel + AuthUiState sealed class. Auto-refresh on 401.

name: android-onboarding
description: OnboardingScreen with Pager (3-screen welcome). QuestionsScreen: 7 full-screen question cards with HorizontalPager, progress indicator, skip support, submit to POST /onboarding/complete. OnboardingViewModel + StateFlow.

name: android-auth-screens
description: LoginScreen (email + password, sign in, sign up nav, error states). RegisterScreen (name, email, password, validation). AuthViewModel. Keyboard avoidance with WindowInsets. Loading states.

name: android-home-screen
description: HomeScreen with character grid. LazyVerticalGrid with CharacterCard composable (avatar circle, name, last message, time, unread badge). "+ Add Character" card. Tap → ChatScreen. Daily summary card. Pull-to-refresh. HomeViewModel + StateFlow.

name: android-chat-screen
description: ChatScreen — core screen. Bubble UI: user right (primary), AI left (surface2 color). SSE streaming via OkHttp EventSource → StateFlow. LazyColumn with reverse layout. Markdown rendering with Markwon. Infinite scroll up (cursor pagination). Send + photo + voice (Faz 5). Character name in TopAppBar. ChatViewModel + ChatUiState. HapticFeedback on send.

name: android-memories-screen
description: MemoriesScreen. TabRow for character selection. Memory list per character. Swipe-to-dismiss with confirmation dialog. EmptyState composable. MemoriesViewModel + StateFlow.

name: android-profile-screen
description: ProfileScreen. Profile photo with image picker + S3 upload. Name/timezone editing. Notification toggles. Language preference. Account management (change password, export, delete). ProfileViewModel.

name: android-fcm-deeplinks
description: Firebase Android SDK. FCM token registration → PUT /notifications/token. Deep link from notification via character_id → navigate to ChatScreen. Background/foreground notification handling. Runtime notification permission (Android 13+).

name: stt-endpoint
description: POST /stt endpoint. Input: {audio_url} (S3 URL). Download audio from S3. Send to OpenAI Whisper API (batch). Return {transcript, language, confidence}. Supported formats: M4A, MP3, WAV, OGG. Max 25MB. Error handling for unsupported formats.

name: tts-endpoint
description: POST /tts endpoint. Input: {text, character_id}. Hybrid strategy: text < 150 chars → AWS Polly (Burcu Neural, fast), text >= 150 chars → ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 (multilingual, 135ms TTFA). Upload MP3 to S3. Return {audio_url, duration_seconds}. Cache: same text+character → return cached S3 URL (24h TTL).

name: ios-voice-recording
description: Add voice recording to iOS ChatView. Hold-to-record mic button (AVAudioRecorder, M4A format, 44100Hz, 2min max). Upload audio to S3 via POST /media/upload-url. Send to POST /stt. Display transcript in message input. Swipe up to cancel recording. Visual recording indicator (waveform animation). Request microphone permission (NSMicrophoneUsageDescription).

name: ios-tts-playback
description: Add TTS playback to iOS ChatView. "Listen" button on AI message bubbles (SF Symbols speaker.wave.2). Tap → POST /tts → AVPlayer playback. Progress bar in message bubble: ▶ 0:08 ─────●──── 0:23. Speed control: 0.75x / 1x / 1.25x / 1.5x. AVAudioSession .playback category. One audio at a time (pause previous on new play).

name: android-voice-recording
description: Add voice recording to Android ChatScreen. Hold-to-record mic button (MediaRecorder, MPEG_4/AAC). Upload to S3. Send to POST /stt. Show transcript in input. Swipe up to cancel. Waveform animation during recording. Runtime RECORD_AUDIO permission request.

name: android-tts-playback
description: Add TTS playback to Android ChatScreen. Listen button on AI message bubbles (Material mic icon). Tap → POST /tts → ExoPlayer (Media3) playback. Custom progress bar composable in message bubble. Speed control 0.75x/1x/1.25x/1.5x via PlaybackParameters.

name: intent-extraction
description: Claude Haiku intent extraction service. Detects in user messages: SET_ALARM {time, label, date}, CALENDAR_WRITE {title, date, time, duration_minutes, confidence}, CALENDAR_READ, CALL_LOG_QUERY. Returns action payload in SSE stream as data: {"type":"action",...}. confidence < 0.7 → AI asks user to confirm. Integrated into chat-streaming service.

name: ios-device-alarms
description: iOS alarm/reminder feature. Handle action event SET_ALARM from SSE stream. Request UNUserNotificationCenter permission. Schedule UNCalendarNotificationTrigger with label + time. Show confirmation UI to user before scheduling. Manage existing alarms (list/cancel via notification identifiers stored in UserDefaults).

name: ios-calendar
description: iOS EventKit calendar integration. Handle CALENDAR_WRITE and CALENDAR_READ actions from SSE. Request EKEventStore calendar access (NSCalendarsUsageDescription + NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescription). Read: EKEventStore.events(matching: predicate) → send to backend as context. Write: show confirmation sheet before EKEvent save. Permission requested on first use only.

name: android-device-alarms
description: Android AlarmManager integration. Handle SET_ALARM action from SSE. AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle() (Android 12+ needs SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM permission). AlarmReceiver BroadcastReceiver. Show confirmation UI before setting. Request SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM permission on first use.

name: android-calendar
description: Android CalendarContract integration. Handle CALENDAR_WRITE and CALENDAR_READ from SSE. Read: ContentResolver query on CalendarContract.Events. Write: show confirmation UI, then CalendarContract.Events.CONTENT_URI insert. Permissions: READ_CALENDAR + WRITE_CALENDAR runtime request on first use.

name: android-call-log
description: Android call log integration. Handle CALL_LOG_QUERY action from SSE. Query CallLog.Calls ContentProvider for last 24h. Send missed/incoming/outgoing calls as context to backend. Request READ_CALL_LOG runtime permission on first use. Note: iOS does not support this (Apple restriction) — Android only feature.

name: vision-endpoint
description: POST /vision endpoint. Input: {image_url, character_id, context}. Download image from S3, encode base64. Send to Claude Sonnet vision. Returns {analysis, suggested_memory, action_prompt}. For food photos: estimate calories, protein, carbs, fat. Suggest Mem0 memory entry. Max image size: 5MB after download.

name: ios-photo-sharing
description: Add photo sharing to iOS ChatView. PHPickerViewController for gallery selection (UIKit wrapped in SwiftUI). Compress to max 1MB (HEIF→JPEG). Upload to S3 via POST /media/upload-url. Send image_url with message. Display photo bubble in chat (Kingfisher). Show analysis result from AI. Option to save analysis to Mem0.

name: android-photo-sharing
description: Add photo sharing to Android ChatScreen. ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia() for gallery. Compress to max 1MB (WEBP preferred). Upload to S3. Send image_url with message. Display photo in chat with Coil. Show analysis result.

name: partner-endpoints
description: Partner connection system. POST /partners/invite (create partners row with invite_token, return invite link). POST /partners/accept?token={token} (set user_id_2, status=active). DELETE /partners/disconnect (set status=disconnected). GET /partners (get current partner status). Backend can share anonymous progress context between partners in AI responses (opt-in).

name: ios-partner-ui
description: Partner section in iOS ProfileView. "Connect a Partner" with share invite link (UIActivityViewController). Accept invite via deep link. Show partner connection status. Toggle anonymous progress sharing. Disconnect option.

name: android-partner-ui
description: Partner section in Android ProfileScreen. Share invite link. Accept via deep link. Connection status card. Anonymous progress sharing toggle. Disconnect.

name: character-templates
description: Character template system. Templates: companion (General Friend), english_teacher, therapist, fitness_coach, career_coach, custom. Each template has base system_prompt with character personality, tone, expertise. Claude Haiku generates personalized system_prompt based on user onboarding data + template. Return generated prompt to user for review/edit before saving.

name: ios-character-management
description: iOS character creation/edit flow. Character selection sheet (template picker with icons and descriptions). Name input. System prompt preview + edit. Avatar style picker (color/shape combos). Creates character via POST /characters. Edit existing via PUT /characters/:id. Delete (deactivate) with confirmation. Max 1 character on free tier, unlimited on premium.

name: android-character-management
description: Android character creation/edit. ModalBottomSheet for template selection. Character name + system prompt preview. Avatar style selection. POST /characters + PUT /characters/:id. Delete confirmation. Subscription tier enforcement.

name: body-measurements-api
description: Body measurements CRUD. POST /body-measurements (create entry: weight_kg, body_fat_pct, notes, date). GET /body-measurements (list, last 90 days). GET /body-measurements/latest (single latest). DELETE /body-measurements/:id. Fitness Coach character automatically adds measurements to Mem0 context.

name: exercisedb-proxy
description: ExerciseDB API proxy. GET /exercises?muscle={muscle}&limit=10 — proxies to ExerciseDB API (api.exercisedb.io). Returns exercise name, description, gifUrl, targetMuscle. Caches responses 24h (Redis or in-memory). No exercise data stored in our DB — only links/GIFs returned to mobile.

name: ios-fitness-ui
description: iOS fitness features. Body measurements entry form (weight, body fat, notes) accessible from chat action or profile. Chart showing weight trend (last 90 days, SwiftUI Charts). Exercise detail view showing ExerciseDB GIF + description when Fitness Coach recommends exercises. Mem0 memories for fitness goals visible in MemoriesView under Fitness category.

name: android-fitness-ui
description: Android fitness features. Body measurements entry. Weight trend chart (MPAndroidChart or Compose Charts). Exercise detail screen with ExerciseDB GIF (Coil). Fitness memories in MemoriesScreen.

name: backend-hardening
description: Backend production hardening. Structured logging (structlog). Sentry error tracking. Request ID middleware. Health check endpoint GET /health. Graceful shutdown. ECS task CPU/memory limits review. Rate limiting verification (20 req/min per user). GDPR: account deletion endpoint (DELETE /account) that deletes all user data: RDS rows, Mem0 memories, S3 files.

name: ios-polish
description: iOS polish. Proper empty states with Lottie animations for all screens. Skeleton loading states. Pull-to-refresh everywhere. Error banners (non-blocking). Offline detection + retry. Dynamic Type support (test at 1.5x). Full accessibility audit (VoiceOver). App icon (1024px) + LaunchScreen polish. TestFlight build.

name: android-polish
description: Android polish. Empty states with Lottie. Shimmer loading. Pull-to-refresh. Error snackbars. Offline handling. Font Scale support (test at 1.3x). TalkBack accessibility. Adaptive icon (foreground + background). Internal testing build for Google Play.

name: ios-localization
description: iOS localization. All user-facing strings to en.lproj/Localizable.strings. Turkish translation (tr.lproj) for Faz 11. String keys: snake_case naming. Pluralization support. Date/time formatting per locale.

name: android-localization
description: Android localization. All strings to values/strings.xml. Turkish to values-tr/strings.xml. Plurals support. Date formatting.

name: store-submission
description: App Store + Google Play submission prep. iOS: Privacy Nutrition Labels, App Store screenshots (6.7", 6.1", iPad), App Review notes, export compliance. Android: Store listing, screenshots (phone + tablet), content rating, data safety form. Backend: final performance test, staging → production migration.

name: livekit-server
description: LiveKit Cloud setup + backend integration. LiveKit room token generation endpoint: POST /voice/token (returns LiveKit JWT for client). Environment vars: LIVEKIT_API_KEY, LIVEKIT_API_SECRET, LIVEKIT_URL.

name: voice-agent
description: LiveKit Agents voice pipeline. VoicePipelineAgent with: VAD=Silero on-device, STT=Deepgram Nova-3 (language=tr, multi), LLM=Claude Haiku with character system_prompt + Mem0 memories, TTS=ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 (latency_optimization=3). Agent connects to LiveKit room, handles conversation. End of call: save transcript to messages table, update Mem0. Cost: ~$0.049/min (Haiku) or ~$0.081/min (Sonnet).

name: ios-voice-call
description: iOS real-time voice call. LiveKit Swift SDK integration. Voice call button in ChatView (SF Symbols phone.fill). Connect to LiveKit room, show in-call UI (avatar animated, mute button, end call). Silero VAD on device. Handle call state transitions (connecting, active, ended).

name: android-voice-call
description: Android real-time voice call. LiveKit Android SDK. Voice call button in ChatScreen. Connect to LiveKit room, in-call composable screen. Mute + end call. Microphone permission handling.

name: rate-limiting-middleware
description: SlowAPI or custom middleware for 20 req/min per user rate limiting. Key by JWT sub claim. Return 429 with Retry-After header. Configurable limits per endpoint group (chat stricter, reads relaxed). Redis or in-memory token bucket.

name: profile-crud-endpoints
description: GET /api/v1/profile (current user profile). PUT /api/v1/profile (update name, timezone, avatar_url, preferred_language). DELETE /api/v1/profile/account (GDPR account deletion: delete profile, all characters, conversations, messages, Mem0 memories, S3 files). Confirmation required via request body.

name: observability-stack
description: Structured logging with structlog (JSON format). Request ID middleware (X-Request-ID header, propagated to all log entries). Sentry error tracking integration. Timing logs for all external API calls (Mem0, Claude, S3). Basic health check dashboard metrics.

name: mem0-circuit-breaker
description: Circuit breaker pattern for Mem0 Cloud. States: closed (normal), open (Mem0 down, skip memory ops), half-open (probe). Local memory cache (last N memories per agent_id, 5min TTL). When circuit open: chat continues without memories, memories queued for retry. Health endpoint reports Mem0 status.

name: llm-provider-abstraction
description: Implement ADR-006 LLMProvider/LLMRouter abstraction. Currently chat_service.py uses AsyncAnthropic directly. Create LLMProvider interface, AnthropicProvider implementation, LLMRouter with provider selection via env var. Prepare for OpenAI/Google fallback providers.

name: openapi-specs
description: Write OpenAPI 3.1 YAML specs in shared/api-contracts/ for all implemented endpoints. Source of truth for mobile clients. Includes request/response schemas, error codes, auth requirements. Auto-validate against FastAPI generated schema.

name: doc-code-sync
description: Resolve all documentation-code contradictions. User→Profile model references, AsyncMemoryClient vs sync client, route prefix consistency, config field names. Update standards docs to match actual implementation. Add CI check for doc-code drift.

name: global-memory-delete
description: DELETE /api/v1/memories/:memId endpoint for global (non-character-scoped) memory deletion. Currently only character-scoped memory delete exists. Validate memory belongs to user via Mem0 metadata check.

name: content-moderation
description: User message content moderation and AI response safety. Leverage Anthropic content filtering. Prompt injection detection and mitigation. Therapist character sensitivity filters. Message length limits (4000 chars user, 8000 chars AI). Abuse rate detection (repeated harmful content → temporary block).

name: ios-offline-queue
description: iOS offline message queue. Detect network status (NWPathMonitor). Queue outgoing messages locally when offline. Auto-send when connection restored. Local conversation cache for reading history offline. SSE reconnection strategy with exponential backoff. Visual offline indicator in UI.

name: android-offline-queue
description: Android offline message queue. ConnectivityManager network status. Room database for local message queue. Auto-retry on reconnection. Local conversation cache. OkHttp EventSource reconnection with exponential backoff. Offline indicator composable.

name: message-archival
description: Messages table archival strategy. Table partitioning by created_at (monthly) or move 90+ day messages to cold storage table. Summarization layer: Claude Haiku generates conversation summary before archival. Archived messages accessible via separate endpoint with pagination.

name: cost-monitoring
description: API cost monitoring dashboard. Track per-user Claude/Mem0/ElevenLabs API costs. COGS tracking per request (token counts, API call durations). Budget alerts when user exceeds threshold. Admin endpoint for cost reports. Monthly cost aggregation.
